name: Kyle T. Yoshida
title: Assistant Professor of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
department: Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering; MOHALA Lab
fitReason: New-2025 Assistant Professor with an unusually useful current worldwide master’s research inquiry and a Summer 2027 application cycle. Full current research establishes neural soft-actuator modeling; learned robot control remains unverified, so this is a lower-physical-confidence robotics-AI backup.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full January 2026 AFREE paper fits SVM and two-layer fully connected neural models to physical soft-actuator measurements, predicting forward twist and inverse fiber configurations. Additional hardware measurements test the models. Genetic design optimization is separately validated on fabricated actuators. The paper explicitly leaves integration of the learned models into robot control/planning to future work; collected actuator data and offline prediction are not executed learned control. The work includes former Washington State collaborators, so current UCLA apparatus access is not inferred.

shortVisit.summary: The live lab opportunities page separately welcomes undergraduate and master’s research applicants at UCLA and around the globe, and lists May 1, 2027 as its Summer 2027 priority deadline. Placement depends on space, funding, capacity and project need. No research duration is specified. The additional Fall 2027 degree-admission instructions are a separate route.
